children: Plus500's acquisition of Brazilian broker-dealer Guru allows it to build a local offering and provide access to U.S. derivatives, Panmure Liberum's Barun Singh writes. Like the online-trading platform's recent purchase of Hedge in the U.S., any contribution from the deal will be positive, Panmure says. "In our view, as with Hedge, the value is the license, market access and team on the ground, not Guru's existing customers or revenue," the analyst notes. Terms for the deal are undisclosed, so Panmure leaves its estimates unchanged. (michael.hennessey@wsj.com)
